title: Belief-Sim: Towards Belief-Driven Simulation of Demographic Misinformation Susceptibility
reasoning: The paper's BeliefSim framework explicitly includes 'Morals & Values' and 'Worldview & Identity' as two of its seven core belief dimensions. It evaluates LLMs using specific data from the World Values Survey (WVS) that encompasses religious self-identification, importance of religion, frequency of religious attendance, and moral judgments regarding the justifiability of various behaviors.
